meta.name: Lockerbay
meta.tagline: Neighbourhood parcel pickups, on your schedule.
meta.summary: A fictional service for collecting parcels from neighbourhood street lockers.

story.headline: Parcel pickup that follows the recipient, not the delivery round.
story.problem: Delivery windows do not always match the time a recipient can reach a shared locker.
story.approach: Give each parcel a pickup code, route locker events through a small booking service, and retry failed notices before parking them for review.
story.outcome: Recipients collect parcels at street lockers while operators can trace every booking and notification attempt.

layers.name: Client
layers.description: Recipients and the phone app they use at a street locker.

components.name: Recipient
components.summary: A person collecting a parcel from a neighbourhood locker.
components.description: Receives a pickup code and uses the app to open the assigned locker.

components.name: Pickup App
components.summary: The Android app that shows pickup codes and locker access.
components.description: Keeps the recipient's active parcel, pickup code, and locker details available at the kerbside.

layers.name: Edge
layers.description: The public entry point and session boundary for pickup requests.

components.name: Pickup API
components.summary: The public entry point for pickup and locker requests.
components.description: Validates app requests and routes bookings, locker events, and notifications to internal services.

components.name: Session Gate
components.summary: Checks that each pickup session is active and belongs to its recipient.
components.description: Issues short-lived session claims before the API accepts a locker action.

layers.name: Services
layers.description: The booking, notification, planning, and audit paths behind a pickup.

components.name: Booking Service
components.summary: Creates and tracks each parcel's locker booking.
components.description: Reserves a locker slot, records the pickup window, and coordinates the services that complete a handoff.

components.name: Notifier
components.summary: Sends pickup codes and collection notices to recipients.
components.description: Subscribes to booking events and delivers each notice through the push gateway.

components.name: Retry Scheduler
components.summary: Queues failed notices for another delivery attempt.
components.description: Waits for a failed push event, retries it on a fixed cadence, and sends exhausted attempts to the dead-letter store.

components.name: Slot Planner
components.summary: Chooses a locker that can hold a parcel for its pickup window.
components.description: Checks locker size and availability before handing the selected slot to the booking service.

components.name: Audit Trail
components.summary: Records every booking and notification state change for operator review.
components.description: Will store an append-only sequence of booking, locker, and delivery events once the planned audit pipeline ships.

layers.name: Storage
layers.description: The records that track locker capacity and undelivered notices.

components.name: Locker Registry
components.summary: The authoritative record of locker locations, sizes, and availability.
components.description: Returns locker metadata and holds the current occupancy state for each street locker.

components.name: Dead Letter Store
components.summary: A durable queue for notices that exhausted their retries.
components.description: Retains failed notification events with their last error so an operator can inspect or replay them.

layers.name: External systems
layers.description: The delivery and hardware boundaries outside Lockerbay.

components.name: Push Gateway
components.summary: A delivery service that forwards mobile push notices.
components.description: Accepts notification payloads from the notifier and reports whether each push was accepted.

components.name: Locker Hardware
components.summary: The physical locker controller that opens doors and reports sensor events.
components.description: Receives unlock commands from the booking service and emits door and parcel-state events.

flows.label: Pickup code delivered
flows.description: A parcel booking reaches the assigned locker and its pickup code is delivered to the recipient.

flows.label: Notice fails, retry queued
flows.description: A failed push is retried before its event moves to the dead-letter store for review.
